snippet.title: Hades II - v1.0 Gameplay Showcase
snippet.description:
The Early Access development of our bewitching sequel to the god-like rogue-like dungeon crawler is complete! Join the Princess of the Dead for a quick tour of the Underworld and beyond.

Play Hades II on Nintendo Switch 2: https://supergiant.games/h2switch2
Play Hades II on Nintendo Switch: https://supergiant.games/h2switch
Play Hades II on Steam: https://supergiant.games/h2steam
Play Hades II on Epic: https://supergiant.games/h2egs
